exitCriteria.title: PENDING or uncorroborated ACTIVE never renders as recorded harvest
exitCriteria.reason: The lifecycle normalizer maps PENDING to planned and ACTIVE to authorised; only RETIRED maps to recorded-harvest. Fixtures exercise every lifecycle.

exitCriteria.title: Québec north of 52 grades national baseline, not enhanced
exitCriteria.reason: The coverage resolver returns national-baseline for Québec at latitude 52 or greater before considering local periods; the coverage query test exercises a latitude of 53. On 2026-09-23 resolve.ts changed for a plain-language wording pass alone; its digest was refreshed, and this reason still holds.

exitCriteria.title: Match rate, non-match rate, and non-match-reason distribution are published on the methods page
exitCriteria.reason: The 2026-09-26 BC and Québec matching run is admitted, published on the methods page in both languages, and released (phase4-provincial-matching-v1). 11.1% of 100,731,284 detected changes match an official record (56% by area). The outside provincial review was retired by the owner the same day and did not take place. On 2026-09-26 the methods text in both languages gained one sentence stating, for British Columbia and Québec, how the loss with no national cause splits by provincial record kind (data/phase4-provincial-cause-crosstab.json, a view of this admitted run); the match rate, the non-match rate, the reason distribution and the admitted run are unchanged, the digests were refreshed, and this reason still holds. On 2026-09-27 a plain-language pass reworded the methods text in both languages and the surrounding methods page. The match rate, the non-match rate, the area share, the reason distribution, the cause split and the admitted run are unchanged; one clause now says the area share is higher because unmatched changes are smaller on average (11.1% by count against 56.1% by area in data/phase4-provincial-matching-report.json). The digests were refreshed, and this reason still holds. Later on 2026-09-27 a site-crawl pass changed punctuation, one spelling and one anchor only: the French methods text and page now put a no-break space before the percent sign, a narrow no-break space before colons and semicolons and no-break spaces inside « »; the English page spells Québec, per the owner's 2026-09-27 decision; and the provincial-matching section carries the id provincial-matching, so Explore's “How the matching works” link lands on it. The match rate, the non-match rate, the area share, the reason distribution, the cause split and the admitted run are unchanged; the digests were refreshed, and this reason still holds.

exitCriteria.title: Salvage, partial cut, and thinning are distinguished where supported and undetermined otherwise
exitCriteria.reason: The event subtype contract allows salvage, partial-cut, and thinning, defaults an omitted source subtype to undetermined, and fixtures/test assertions exercise all four outcomes.

localControls: The optional-enhancement availability gate protects absent optional data as bilingual Unknown; it does not substitute for the separate rights/admission or outside-review checkpoints.
